Anchisa Chanta ( Thai : อัญชิสา ฉันทะ ; born 12 September 2002) is a Thai inactive tennis player.
She has a career-high singles ranking of world No. 456, achieved on 18 September 2023, by the WTA .  She also has a career-high doubles ranking of No. 517, reached on 16 October 2019. She has won four singles and four doubles titles on the ITF Circuit. Chanta also represents Thailand in Fed Cup competition.
